description: Source code implementing address sorting logic for IPv6/IPv4 addresses based on RFC3484, including network interface handling and address policy rules.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix
classes.description: Implements address sorting based on RFC3484 policies, handling network interface changes and address preferences.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix::SortContext
classes.description: Manages the context for sorting a list of destination addresses asynchronously.

methods.name: AddressSorterPosix::Sort
methods.description: Initiates sorting of a list of IP endpoints asynchronously.

methods.description: Updates internal address policy data when network interfaces change.

methods.description: Fills in address policy information such as scope and label.

methods.name: AddressSorterPosix::FinishedSort
methods.description: Cleans up after sorting is complete.
